description: Servicio WMS (Web Map Service) Zonas de alto potencial para el desarrollo de la energía eólica marina is a dataset listed in Official INSPIRE Data and Services Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wms.mapama.gob.es. The WMS Service (Web Map Service) called "High Potential Areas for the Development of Offshore Wind Energy" allows the visualization and consultation of the data set that represents the cartographic and alphanumeric information of the areas of high potential for the development of offshore wind energy determined in the Maritime Spatial Planning Plans (POEM). Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "WMS Service (Web Map Service) High Potential Areas for Offshore Wind Energy Development" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-codsi.
